description: Source code for Mach-O file header and load command parsing, part of the breakpad crash reporting library, specifically for macOS architecture.

classes.name: MachoWalker
classes.description: Class responsible for iterating over Mach-O headers and load commands in a file or memory buffer.

methods.name: WalkHeader
methods.description: Initiates walking through the Mach-O header, selecting 32-bit or 64-bit based on CPU type.

methods.name: ReadBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from file or memory at a given offset.

methods.name: CurrentHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the current Mach-O header and its offset.

methods.name: FindHeader
methods.description: Locates the Mach-O header in file or memory matching specified CPU type/subtype.

methods.name: WalkHeaderAtOffset
methods.description: Processes a Mach-O header at a specific file/memory offset.

methods.name: WalkHeader64AtOffset
methods.description: Processes a 64-bit Mach-O header at a specific offset.

methods.name: WalkHeaderCore
methods.description: Iterates over load commands within a Mach-O header, invoking a callback.
